audit_items.proof_trace: The `getMonthlyAttendance` server action uses `createSupabaseAdminClient()` (service role key, bypasses RLS entirely) and accepts a caller-supplied `userId` parameter with no authorization check — there is no `getUser()` call, no `is_admin` guard, and no assertion that `userId == session.user.id`. As a `'use server'` exported function, it is callable by any authenticated user via the Next.js server action RPC mechanism, allowing any non-admin to request any other user's monthly attendance records.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin user obtains a victim's Supabase UUID (visible in page DOM or inferred from other responses), then directly invokes the `getMonthlyAttendance` Next.js server action with the victim's UUID and a chosen month; the server returns the victim's full attendance calendar (dates and check-in/out status) because the admin client bypasses RLS and no ownership check exists.
